description: Sonnet as the main model, Opus as the advisor it consults at decision points, and Haiku for every subagent, including agents whose definition pins another model (remove CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE to let them keep theirs). Uses aliases, so it follows the latest version of each family. The advisor needs the Anthropic API and stays off when DISABLE_TELEMETRY or CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC is set; the force flag needs Claude Code v2.1.257+.
